step1_analysis.description: This circuit generates a virtual supply voltage (VDDV) using a diode-connected PMOS and uses it to precharge a read bitline (RBL) and an internal node (O2) through PMOS switches. Several transistors are configured as dummy capacitors to model bitline and node parasitic capacitances.

VDDV_Level.description: Steady-state voltage of the virtual supply node VDDV.

sky130_expected.calculation: VDDV = VDD - |Vthp|. For VDD=1.8V and |Vthp| ≈ 0.42V, VDDV ≈ 1.38V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The diode-connected PMOS (XM5) drops one threshold voltage from the main supply.

Precharge_Delay_RBL.description: Time required to precharge the Read Bitline (RBL) to 1.0V after SA_WL goes low.

sky130_expected.calculation: t = (C_RBL * V) / I_PMOS. C_RBL is dominated by XM4 and XM7 gate caps (~50fF). I_PMOS for W=5u is ~1mA. t ≈ (50fF * 1V) / 1mA = 50ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the exact parasitic capacitance of the dummy transistors in SKY130.

Precharge_Delay_O2.description: Time required to precharge node O2 to 1.0V after O1 goes low.

sky130_expected.calculation: Similar to RBL, O2 is loaded by XM2 and XM6 (~50fF). Delay should be on the same order of magnitude as RBL.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric loading and identical PMOS switch sizing (W=5u, L=0.5u) yields similar delay.

Energy_Per_Precharge.description: Total energy drawn from VDD to precharge the internal nodes and bitlines.

sky130_expected.calculation: E = C_total * VDDV * VDD. C_total ≈ 150fF. E ≈ 150fF * 1.38V * 1.8V ≈ 370fJ.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper's 0.57nJ metric is for an entire pixel processing operation. This specific sub-circuit only charges a few local capacitors, so its energy is in the femtojoule range.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench to measure the virtual supply voltage level, precharge delays for RBL and O2, and total precharge energy.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Precharge Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Input Stimulus
VSA_WL SA_WL 0 PULSE(1.8 0 1n 0.1n 0.1n 4n 10n)
VO1 O1 0 PULSE(1.8 0 2n 0.1n 0.1n 4n 10n)

* DUT
XM1 GND O1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 GND O2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VDDV SA_WL RBL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 GND RBL GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VDDV VDDV VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VDD O2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 VDDV RBL RBL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 O2 O1 VDDV VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Initial conditions to ensure nodes start discharged
.ic v(RBL)=0 v(O2)=0 v(VDDV)=0

.control
tran 10p 10n

* Measure VDDV steady state (approx max value)
meas tran vddv_max max v(VDDV)

* Measure precharge delay for RBL
meas tran t_rbl_rise trig v(SA_WL) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(RBL) val=1.0 rise=1

* Measure precharge delay for O2
meas tran t_o2_rise trig v(O1) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(O2) val=1.0 rise=1

* Measure total energy consumed during the 10ns window
meas tran i_integ integ i(VVDD) from=0 to=10n
let energy = -i_integ * 1.8
print energy

quit
.endc
